description: Read a single paper in full: its title, track, status, the reviews written on it with each reviewer's scores and comments, the average per criterion, any rebuttal from the authors, the meta-review, and the decision if one has been recorded. Use it whenever the question is about a specific submission rather than a count — 'what did the reviewers say about this paper', 'why is this one scored low', 'is this ready to decide', or to summarize the reviews before recording a decision. Call list_submissions first to find the submission's id. Reviewer names and their comments to the organizers are included, so treat the result as confidential to the committee and do not quote the organizer-facing comments back to an author. Requires an OAuth connection rather than an API key, and the admin or committee role on the event — the same access the dashboard's decision queue needs.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: get_submission
title: Read one submission and its reviews
